components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:16px; padding:15px 24px; min-height:50px; background:var(--vy-red, #951D2A); color:#FFFFFF; border:0; border-radius:5px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; transition:background .18s; font-family:var(--vy-sans, "Be Vietnam Pro", sans-serif); line-height:1.65; cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--vy-red-dark, #761524); } .ds-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--vy-red, #951D2A); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.42; }

components.name: Text action

components.name: Compact choice picker
components.description: Native inline disclosure showing its label and selected value; application rows supply catalogue images and selection handlers.
components.html: Sự kiệnLễ hội dân gian
components.css: .ds-picker { margin-top:12px; border:1px solid #DCCFC4; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; color:var(--vy-ink, #302528); font-family:var(--vy-sans, "Be Vietnam Pro", sans-serif); line-height:1.65; } .ds-picker summary { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:3px 8px; align-items:center; padding:13px 14px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none; } .ds-picker summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-picker summary>span { grid-column:1; font-size:11px; color:var(--vy-muted, #756367); } .ds-picker summary>strong { grid-column:1; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; min-width:0; } .ds-picker summary>svg { grid-column:2; grid-row:1/3; transition:transform .2s; } .ds-picker[open] summary { border-bottom:1px solid var(--vy-line, #DECFB9); } .ds-picker[open] summary>svg { transform:rotate(180deg); } .ds-options { display:flex; flex-direction:column; max-height:320px; overflow-y:auto; } .ds-option { min-height:65px; padding:10px 12px; width:100%; border:0; background:#FFFFFF; color:var(--vy-ink, #302528); text-align:left; font-size:12px; font-family:var(--vy-sans, "Be Vietnam Pro", sans-serif); line-height:1.65; cursor:pointer; } .ds-option:hover { background:#F7F1ED; } .ds-option.ds-selected { background:#F1E4DF; } .ds-picker summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--vy-red, #951D2A); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--vy-red, #951D2A); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-option:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.42; }

components.name: Person segmented control

components.css: .ds-studio-collection { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.7fr 2fr 1fr; gap:30px; align-items:center; padding:35px clamp(22px,3vw,46px); background:#EDE5D7; border-top:1px solid #DDCCB5; border-bottom:1px solid #DDCCB5; font-family:var(--vy-sans,"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif); } .ds-studio-mark { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:start; gap:9px; color:#74121C; } .ds-studio-mark>span { font-family:var(--vy-serif,"Noto Serif Display","Noto Serif",serif); font-size:30px; } .ds-studio-collection h2 { margin:0; font-size:27px; font-weight:650; line-height:1.3; color:#74121C; } .ds-studio-collection p { max-width:54ch; margin:12px 0 0; font-size:13px; line-height:1.8; color:#605247; } .ds-studio-collection a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:44px; margin-top:9px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:#74121C; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:5px; } .ds-studio-collection a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-studio-collection a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #951D2A; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-studio-themes { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:end; gap:10px; } .ds-studio-themes>span { padding:6px 16px; border:1px solid #BAA084; border-radius:20px; color:#69513A; font-family:var(--vy-serif,"Noto Serif Display","Noto Serif",serif); font-size:17px; } .ds-studio-themes>span:nth-child(2) { margin-right:24px; border-color:#749080; color:#2D5141; } .ds-studio-themes>span:last-child { margin-right:8px; border-color:#A46F70; color:#7A3038; } @media(max-width:759px) { .ds-studio-collection { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:19px; padding:28px 22px; } .ds-studio-mark { flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:13px; } .ds-studio-mark>span { font-size:24px; } .ds-studio-themes { flex-direction:row; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px; } .ds-studio-themes>span,.ds-studio-themes>span:nth-child(2),.ds-studio-themes>span:last-child { margin:0; font-size:14px; padding:4px 12px; } }

narrative.overview:
Nền giấy ngà ấm, sắc đỏ có chủ đích và hình ảnh trang phục giữ bản sắc Việt Y. Noto Serif Display tạo nhịp biên tập cho tư liệu, tên áo và thương hiệu; Be Vietnam Pro phục vụ thao tác và tiêu đề thẳng rõ của trang chủ. Nội dung đọc có khoảng thở, xưởng ưu tiên scan và thao tác.

Home now implements the user-approved B direction, “Phòng phối sáng tạo”: a compact crimson textile hero with an authored fashion plate, strong upright sans-serif copy and warm gold workshop action. Ivory sections introduce the composition flow, actual garment covers, a graphic Lookbook introduction and cultural reading. This is a Home-specific expression of the product; the existing navigation, workshop, shared Lookbook and cultural routes retain their established palette and component grammar. The old oversized heritage hero and its flourish/wave composition are superseded on Home.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory paper and deliberate red; Home uses warm gold for its primary action.
Serif editorial accents paired with Vietnamese sans-serif controls and Home display type.
Compact crimson Home hero, followed immediately by tangible catalogue previews.
A collapsible left navigation and compact selection controls.
Separate rhythms for reading, image browsing, and outfit composition.

rules.name: The Route Palette Rule
rules.body: Preserve shared red action/selection states; Home alone uses warm gold for the hero workshop action and its local studio palette.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Preserve serif editorial accents and sans-serif interaction; Home also uses the sans-serif for its main display message.

rules.name: The Paper Layers Rule
rules.body: Use the implemented paper tones, borders, and image framing to distinguish surfaces.

dos: Do preserve shared ivory/red identity and Home's local crimson, warm gold and garment-cover palette.
Do preserve the approved compact Home hero and code-based message/actions; use the documented mobile copy-then-art order.
Do keep serif editorial accents and Be Vietnam Pro Home display/interaction roles distinct.
Do generate Home previews and garment links from catalogue data without fixed inventory-count copy.
Do keep Home's Lookbook introduction photographic-tile-free and its shared mock destination truthfully described.
Do let photographs of garments and places carry the cultural content.
Do keep workshop controls independently scrollable while the preview stays visible.
Do preserve explicit selected, loading, empty, retry, and disabled states.
Do keep cultural detail pages and image details addressable through normal navigation.
donts: Don't apply Home's gold actions, display scale or compact section rhythm to other routes without a separate design decision.
Don't replace garment or location photography with decorative boxes or icons.
Don't add long technology labels or disclaimers to the main workshop flow.
Don't present demo testimonials as verified customer evidence.
Don't imply VTO, personal uploads, or workshop saving are implemented.
Don't reinterpret catalogue garment colors as the interface palette.
